title: ContentItem Core Fields (part of composed schema)
description: Core fields of media content items in the Impresso project.

id.description: Unique identifier for the content item
id.title: Content Item ID

meta_journal_s.description: Media title alias. Will soon be deprecated in favor of meta_media_s.

meta_media_alias_s.description: Media title alias. Will soon be deprecated in favor of meta_media_s.
meta_media_alias_s.title: Media Title Alias

meta_date_dt.description: Full date and time in ISO 8601 format

meta_source_type_s.description: Type of the media source. Should be a value from impresso-essentials.utils SourceType enum.

meta_source_medium_s.description: Medium of the source (audio for audio radio broadcasts, print for newspapers, typescript for digitised radio bulletin typescripts).

meta_radio_program_s.title: Radio Program
meta_radio_program_s.description: Radio program name the broadcast belongs to. Sourced from 'radio_program' key in additional_metadata. Provider: RTS.

meta_radio_channel_s.title: Radio Channel
meta_radio_channel_s.description: Radio channel the broadcast was aired on. Sourced from 'radio_channel' key in additional_metadata. Provider: RTS.
